query:
select k.e, k.v, (select count(*) from "core/same_as" sa where sa.e = k.e) as dup, (select count(*) from "core/same_as" sa where sa.v = k.e) as dups_of
from "sku/code" k where k.v = 'AH-KTL-0001-BLK'
select f.a, count(distinct sa.e) from "core/same_as" sa join facts f on f.e = sa.e group by f.a order by 2 desc

select x.attr, f.a, count(distinct x.e) from (
 select 'supersedes' attr, e from "core/supersedes"
 union all select 'valid_from', e from "core/valid_from"
 union all select 'valid_to', e from "core/valid_to"
 union all select 'period', e from "core/period"
 union all select 'currency', e from "core/currency"
 union all select 'confidence', e from "core/confidence"
 union all select 'on_behalf_of', e from "core/on_behalf_of"
 union all select 'evidence', e from "core/evidence"
) x join facts f on f.e = x.e group by 1,2 order by 1,2

select b.v as booking_no, st.v as status, eta.v as eta, sum(q.v) as units, count(*) as nlines
from "sku/code" k
join "po_line/sku" pls on pls.v = k.e
join "shipment_line/po_line" slp on slp.v = pls.e
join "shipment_line/quantity" q on q.e = slp.e
join "core/part_of" po on po.e = slp.e
join "shipment/booking_no" b on b.e = po.v
join "shipment/status" st on st.e = b.e
left join "shipment/eta" eta on eta.e = b.e
where k.v = 'AH-KTL-0001-BLK'
group by b.v, st.v, eta.v
order by b.v
select f.a, count(distinct sl.e) from "shipment_line/key" sl join facts f on f.e = sl.e group by f.a

select b.v as booking, sl.v as line_key, k.v as sku, q.v as qty
from "shipment/booking_no" b join "shipment/status" st using (e)
join "core/part_of" p on p.v = b.e
join "shipment_line/key" sl on sl.e = p.e
join "shipment_line/quantity" q on q.e = p.e
join "shipment_line/po_line" pl on pl.e = p.e
left join "po_line/sku" ps on ps.e = pl.v
left join "sku/code" k on k.e = ps.v
where st.v in ('departed','arrived') order by 1,2

select n.v as po, h.v, h.op, h.tx
from "supplier/code" s
join "po/supplier" ps on ps.v = s.e
join "po/number" n on n.e = ps.e
join history."po/etd" h on h.e = n.e
where s.v = 'NBBW'
order by n.v, h.tx, h.op

with first_etd as (
  select distinct on (h.e) h.e, h.v
  from history."po/etd" h where h.op = 'assert' order by h.e, h.tx
)
select n.v as po_number, f.v as first_etd, cur.v as current_etd
from "supplier/code" s
join "po/supplier" ps on ps.v = s.e
join "po/number" n on n.e = ps.e
join "po/etd" cur on cur.e = n.e
join first_etd f on f.e = n.e
where s.v = 'NBBW' and cur.v > f.v
order by n.v

select b.v as booking_no, st.v as status, eta.v as eta
from "shipment/booking_no" b
join "shipment/status" st using (e)
left join "shipment/eta" eta using (e)
where st.v in ('departed','arrived')
order by b.v

select at.e, at.v from "fs/at" at where at.e between 103800 and 103830 or at.e = (select max(e) from "fs/at" where v < '2026-07-01T00:00:00Z') or at.e = (select min(e) from "fs/at" where v >= '2026-07-01T00:00:00Z') order by at.e
select e, a, v, tx from facts where e in (103813, 103815, 1000) order by e, a

select n.v as entry, f.v as filed_on, ev.v as entered_value, d.v as duty, fe.v as fees, c.v as currency
from "customs/entry_no" n
left join "customs/filed_on" f using (e)
left join "customs/entered_value" ev using (e)
left join "customs/duty" d using (e)
left join "customs/fees" fe using (e)
left join "core/currency" c using (e)
order by f.v

select count(*) as entries, sum(ev.v) as entered_value, sum(d.v) as duty, sum(fe.v) as fees
from "customs/entry_no" n
join "customs/filed_on" f using (e)
left join "customs/entered_value" ev using (e)
left join "customs/duty" d using (e)
left join "customs/fees" fe using (e)
where f.v between '2026-04-01' and '2026-06-30'

select sc.v as supplier_code, r.v as result, count(*) as count
from "qc/report_no" q
join "qc/inspected_on" d on d.e = q.e
left join "qc/result" r on r.e = q.e
left join "qc/po" qp on qp.e = q.e
left join "po/supplier" ps on ps.e = qp.v
left join "supplier/code" sc on sc.e = ps.v
where d.v >= '2026-01-01' and d.v < '2027-01-01'
group by sc.v, r.v
order by sc.v, r.v
select f.e, f.a, f.v, f.tx from "amazon/asin" a join facts f on f.e = a.e where a.v = 'B0BVUGZ3AT' order by f.a

select k.v as sku_code, sv.v as shopify_variant_id, fn.v as fnsku, ss.v as seller_sku, tpl.v as tpl_item_code, fi.v as factory_item_code, sc.v as supplier_code
from "amazon/asin" a
join "sku/code" k on k.e = a.e
left join "shopify/variant_id" sv on sv.e = a.e
left join "amazon/fnsku" fn on fn.e = a.e
left join "amazon/seller_sku" ss on ss.e = a.e
left join "tpl/item_code" tpl on tpl.e = a.e
left join "factory/item_code" fi on fi.e = a.e
left join "sku/supplier" ks on ks.e = a.e
left join "supplier/code" sc on sc.e = ks.v
where a.v = 'B0BVUGZ3AT'

select sc.v as supplier, scur.v as supplier_currency, s.v as status, c.v as po_currency, count(distinct n.e) as pos
from "po/number" n
left join "po/status" s using (e)
left join "core/currency" c using (e)
left join "po/supplier" ps using (e)
left join "supplier/code" sc on sc.e = ps.v
left join "supplier/currency" scur on scur.e = ps.v
group by 1,2,3,4 order by 1,3
select f.a, count(distinct k.e), count(*) from "po_line/key" k join facts f on f.e = k.e group by f.a

select sc.v as supplier_code, c.v as currency, sum(q.v * p.v) as value, count(*) as nlines, count(distinct po.e) as npos, string_agg(distinct n.v, ',') as pos
from "po/number" n
join "po/status" s on s.e = n.e
join "po/supplier" ps on ps.e = n.e
join "supplier/code" sc on sc.e = ps.v
left join "core/currency" c on c.e = n.e
join "core/part_of" po on po.v = n.e
join "po_line/quantity" q on q.e = po.e
join "po_line/unit_price" p on p.e = po.e
where s.v not in ('shipped','received')
group by sc.v, c.v
order by sc.v

with recursive up(e, depth) as (
  select c.e, 0 from "shopify/customer_id" c where c.v = '8995877069469'
  union
  select sa.v, up.depth + 1 from up join "core/same_as" sa on sa.e = up.e
),
root as (select e from up where not exists (select 1 from "core/same_as" sa where sa.e = up.e)),
down(e) as (
  select e from root
  union
  select sa.e from down join "core/same_as" sa on sa.v = down.e
)
select d.e, c.v as customer_id, sa.v as same_as,
  (select count(*) from "order/customer" oc where oc.v = d.e) as orders_all,
  (select count(*) from "order/customer" oc join "shopify/order_id" so on so.e = oc.e where oc.v = d.e) as shopify_orders
from down d left join "shopify/customer_id" c on c.e = d.e left join "core/same_as" sa on sa.e = d.e
order by d.e
select oc.e, oc.v, f.a, f.v from "order/customer" oc join facts f on f.e = oc.e where oc.v in (21552, 21553, 48170) order by oc.e, f.a

select name.v as actor, etd.tx as transaction, at.v as recorded_at, etd.v as etd
from "po/number" n
join "po/etd" etd on etd.e = n.e
join "fs/at" at on at.e = etd.tx
join "fs/actor" a on a.e = etd.tx
join "fs/name" name on name.e = a.v
where n.v = 'PO-2026-0023'

select h.v, h.op, h.tx, at.v as at, name.v as actor, (select string_agg(f.a || '=' || f.v, '; ') from facts f where f.e = h.tx) as txfacts
from "po/number" n
join history."po/etd" h on h.e = n.e
join "fs/at" at on at.e = h.tx
join "fs/actor" a on a.e = h.tx
join "fs/name" name on name.e = a.v
where n.v = 'PO-2026-0023' order by h.tx, h.op

select lc.v as location_code, lk.v as kind, iq.v as quantity, ip.v as position, ca.v as counted_at
from "sku/code" k
join "inventory/sku" isk on isk.v = k.e
join "inventory/location" il on il.e = isk.e
join "location/code" lc on lc.e = il.v
left join "location/kind" lk on lk.e = il.v
left join "inventory/quantity" iq on iq.e = isk.e
left join "inventory/position" ip on ip.e = isk.e
left join "inventory/counted_at" ca on ca.e = isk.e
where k.v = 'AH-TWL-0007-NAT'
order by lc.v

select ip.e, ip.v, isk.v as sku_e, il.v as loc_e, iq.v
from "inventory/position" ip left join "inventory/sku" isk using (e) left join "inventory/location" il using (e) left join "inventory/quantity" iq using (e)
where ip.v ilike '%TWL-0007-NAT%'
union all
select lc.e, lc.v || ' / ' || coalesce(lk.v,'?'), null, null, null from "location/code" lc left join "location/kind" lk using (e)

with recursive up(e) as (
  select c.e from "shopify/customer_id" c where c.v = '8995877069469'
  union
  select sa.v from up join "core/same_as" sa on sa.e = up.e
),
root as (select e from up where not exists (select 1 from "core/same_as" sa where sa.e = up.e)),
person(e) as (
  select e from root
  union
  select sa.e from person join "core/same_as" sa on sa.v = person.e
)
select (select count(*) from person) as accounts,
       (select count(distinct oc.e) from "order/customer" oc join "shopify/order_id" so on so.e = oc.e join person p on p.e = oc.v) as orders

select sc.v as supplier_code, c.v as currency, sum(q.v * p.v) as value
from "po/number" n
join "po/status" s on s.e = n.e
join "po/supplier" ps on ps.e = n.e
join "supplier/code" sc on sc.e = ps.v
left join "core/currency" c on c.e = n.e
join "core/part_of" line on line.v = n.e
join "po_line/quantity" q on q.e = line.e
join "po_line/unit_price" p on p.e = line.e
where s.v not in ('shipped','received')
group by sc.v, c.v
order by sc.v

select b.v as booking_no, st.v as status, eta.v as eta, sum(q.v) as units
from "sku/code" k
join "po_line/sku" pls on pls.v = k.e
join "shipment_line/po_line" slp on slp.v = pls.e
join "shipment_line/quantity" q on q.e = slp.e
join "core/part_of" po on po.e = slp.e
join "shipment/booking_no" b on b.e = po.v
join "shipment/status" st on st.e = b.e
left join "shipment/eta" eta on eta.e = b.e
where k.v = 'AH-KTL-0001-BLK' and st.v in ('departed','arrived')
group by b.v, st.v, eta.v
order by b.v

select lc.v as location_code, lk.v as kind, iq.v as quantity
from "sku/code" k
join "inventory/sku" isk on isk.v = k.e
join "inventory/location" il on il.e = isk.e
join "location/code" lc on lc.e = il.v
join "location/kind" lk on lk.e = il.v
join "inventory/quantity" iq on iq.e = isk.e
where k.v = 'AH-TWL-0007-NAT' and lk.v in ('factory','in_transit')
order by lc.v
